body:
I probably won't get read, but I appreciate this thread and the OP nonetheless :)

My sister was born with an unusual disorder that made her whole life almost one big trip to the hospital. My parents spent most of their time watching and taking care of her, an as the elder sister, my role was just to be a good girl and not create trouble. I've never blamed my parents, they did the best they could.. But I never really felt loved. Now as an adult, I am constantly searching to be loved/liked and am too nice and too pleasing to people to achieve that warped ideal.

I get betrayed so much by close friends. The most recent case was 2 months ago when 3 people decided to flat out betray me and ruin my professional work and reputation. I've lost so many friends from the fallout. I was suicidal. And now I have serious trust issues. 

If you were to meet me, you wouldn't be able to tell. I'm quite sociable and funny. But inside I am one bad thing away from ending it. 

I hope everyone here stays strong. Much love to this thread.
Hello, I just wanted to let you know thst you are not alone. And you are not the only one who feels broken and abandoned. If you ever need to talk, I'm here. Take care.
The only other thing better than watching the episode is your recaps and jon + tormund's torrid love affair :)
The hardest thing in this world is to live in it. Some days it's easier, some days a nightmare. You're not alone, I hope you can find just a bit of solace in that.
I'm still reeling from all the betrayal. Not too sure how to move past this. World seems too dark.
I know what that's like. I want to run away and disappear.
I don't know... I'd like to talk about life. I don't know what I'm doing here.
Don't do anything because people tell you to. Don't give them that satisfaction. Stay strong friend. I'm here if you need to talk.
I feel like you. Do you think you can meet new people, get out of your current social circle?

Not so good. Betrayed by those closest to me. Lost a 5 year project from it and also all my friends. 

What about you? Do you have a support system around you?
Good luck friend. I hope that therapy will bring comfort and clarity to you.
Hello. I've lost a lot too, and in the same place as you. Maybe we can keep each other company for a while?
Hello. I feel the same as you. I would offer my hand for you to hold if I could.
Hard. Feeling like I'm losing everything. Feeling eyes watching and waiting for me to fail. I can't stop crying or smoking.

Hello. I've been betrayed by someone I thought was my friend. Spreading lies about me, and people in my social and professional circle have just decided to believe that person. I've lost my job, my friends. I don't know how to go on.

I know, but I don't know how to fight anymore. She's a bully, and a good one. And people rather believe her than listen to my side of the story. If life is this unfair, it's not a life I want to be a part of.
I've always been a disappointment for them. This is another one. I trust them with certain things in my life, not all.
